propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads the floor file from the checked-out patchset tree but errors when absent, while Gerrit's Verified lane sources the workflow definition from the target branch, causing any change branched before the gate merged to fail hard regardless of content.
In-flight changes branched before c433663721 merged lack .github/git-version-floor.txt in their tree but receive the new gate step from main, producing false Verified -1 votes on unrelated changes.

The gate violates the established repository pattern documented in ticket ee2a: new gate steps that run repo artifacts must skip with a log line when the artifact is absent from the checked-out tree, rather than hard-failing.
Applying the if-present guard (skip on absent file, log the tree-skew reason, re-enforce on rebase) preserves genuine under-floor enforcement while allowing pre-gate changes to pass without rebasing.
